name: Video encoder
responsibility: Finds ffmpeg, proves it has the encoders the file needs, and turns the JPEG frames and the voice into that file
description: ARCHBOARD_FFMPEG comes first, and one named there that does not run is refused by that name, never passed over. Then ffmpeg on PATH, then nix run nixpkgs#ffmpeg-headless. With none of them, ENCODER_UNAVAILABLE names both ways to get one. MP4 needs libx264 and aac, and WebM needs libvpx-vp9 and libopus. The frames are converted from full-range BT.601 to BT.709 limited range and tagged so, and the voice is padded to the last frame.
